digest.component_or_area: CI/CD pipeline — pytest cell execution (macOS gate)
propositions: The macOS pytest cell runs the full default test suite plus integration tier, causing it to be ~3.7x slower per test than Ubuntu and the sole long pole in the Gerrit Verified Gate (macOS ~2140s vs Ubuntu ~572s)
macOS process-spawn and git-store fixture overhead are the primary bottleneck; the CPU-bound AST/policy scanners perform equally or faster on macOS than Linux
Running the full test breadth on the slow macOS runner provides latency cost without proportional confidence gain versus a platform-sensitive subset

A centralized auto-marker in tests/conftest.py must apply platform_compat to file paths containing OS-sensitive behavior (locking, atomicity, subprocess timeout, cross-process contention) to prevent silent suite drift and ensure Ubuntu retains full coverage

The macOS DEFAULT_SUITE_MARKS expression must change from a two-branch ternary to a three-branch expression selecting 'platform_compat and not external' on macOS while Ubuntu keeps 'not integration and not external'

The marker registration, conftest automation, workflow conditional, and parity guard tests must all be implemented and validated to prevent the macOS suite from silently shrinking below the core platform-sensitive test set
